title: 단골
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop indie pop ballad. Clean electric guitar plays a repetitive arpeggiated pattern with light chorus and delay. A soft, breathy female vocal performs a melodic, conversational delivery. Sub-bass pulses on the downbeats. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the guitar and the vocal. Tempo is 78 BPM in the key of G Major. The production features high-end clarity with intimate vocal proximity.

[Intro]
[arpeggiated clean electric guitar with chorus]

어떤 걸 그릴지는
